assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: architectural photographic website asset for a fictional dental clinic portfolio concept, not a real clinic claim, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: portrait 4:5 architectural photograph of an inviting modern dental treatment room with pale natural oak cabinetry, off-white walls, forest green accents, and professionally plausible modern dental chair and equipment.
Scene/backdrop: a clean, calm treatment room with a large daylight window, neat oak storage and work surface, restrained forest-green dental chair upholstery. Credible clinical layout with articulated examination lamp, dentist delivery unit with orderly handpiece hoses, assistant stool and integrated equipment; all coherently constructed.
Style/medium: premium honest architectural interior photography with natural material detail, accurate perspective and verticals, not illustration or 3D rendering.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5 frame, view from the room entrance at normal human eye level showing the dental chair as the focus and enough surrounding architecture to feel welcoming, spacious and plausible.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight, warm calm atmosphere, gentle realistic shadows.
Materials/textures: natural pale oak grain, matte off-white paint, smooth professional chair upholstery, clean neutral floor.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no signs, no watermarks, no distorted equipment, no excessive decorative objects. Produce one single photograph.
